# Terminal assets

Vendored from official npm registry packages, with SHA-512 distribution integrity checked:

- `@xterm/xterm` 5.5.0: `xterm.js`, `xterm.css`, `LICENSE.xterm`
- `@xterm/addon-fit` 0.10.0: `xterm-fit.js`, `LICENSE.xterm-fit`

Both are MIT licensed. Assets are embedded locally and loaded only when a terminal
is opened or an existing session is reattached. No CDN or Node runtime is used.
